title: Case 042: Warehouse has no forklift for a booked pallet delivery

details.source_role: Voren Tesk, Fenwick Spur receiving coordinator
details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The consignee has no forklift. The carrier planner can offer a tail-lift service only under the confirmed pallet and site conditions.
initial_request: Our booking account authorises me to accept up to GBP 30.00 total extra service cost. Please arrange the carrier’s suitable option if it fits that limit.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the carrier planner to arrange the appropriate unloading service under the agreed booking terms.

outcome: The planner confirms a suitable vehicle and agreed service cost; unloading remains pending.
boundaries: No manual-lifting advice. Planner allocation and authorised cost are not payment or completed unloading.

events.from: Freight account services, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: Inline verified booking record DL-042: one 280 kg pallet; consignee declares no forklift, level hard-surfaced delivery bay and clear vehicle access. Registered coordinator Voren Tesk has a verified business-portal channel and spending authority for up to GBP 30.00 total additional unloading cost. Consignee staff are not authorised to manually unload the pallet.

events.from: Voren Tesk, Fenwick Spur receiving coordinator
events.body: Our booking account authorises me to accept up to GBP 30.00 total extra service cost. Please arrange the carrier’s suitable option if it fits that limit.

Please arrange an appropriate unloading service for DL-042, one 280 kg pallet at the declared level hard-surfaced bay. No consignee forklift. Verified coordinator Voren authorises up to GBP 30.00 total extra cost.

Tail-lift vehicle and trained unloading crew allocated for DL-042 on 2026-03-16, 09:00–12:00 UTC. Total service addition GBP 24.00 under the recorded authority. Driver will assess conditions on arrival; no unloading has occurred.
